Elden Ring is an action role-playing game developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, released on February 25, 2022 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki with worldbuilding provided by George R.R. Martin, the game is set in the Lands Between where players control a customizable character on a quest to repair the Elden Ring and become the new Elden Lord.

The game features an open world that can be traversed using a steed named Torrent, with linear hidden dungeons for exploring to find useful items. Players engage enemies using various weapons and magic spells and can focus on non-direct engagement enabled by stealth mechanics. The game's world contains checkpoints that enable fast travel and allow players to improve their attributes using an in-game currency called runes.

Elden Ring features an online multiplayer mode, allowing players to join for cooperative play to fight bosses or engage in player versus player combat. FromSoftware aimed to create an open-world game based on Dark Souls, with Martin contributing to the backstory and Miyazaki acting as lead writer for the in-game narrative.

Elden Ring received several Game of the Year awards and has been cited as one of the greatest games of all time. It sold over 30 million copies, making it one of the best-selling games of all time. The downloadable content (DLC) Shadow of the Erdtree was released in June 2024 to similar acclaim and sold over ten million copies. A multiplayer-focused spinoff game, Elden Ring Nightreign, was released in 2025.

You can purchase Elden Ring on Steam for PC or console versions like PlayStation 5, PS4, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. The standalone adventure, Elden Ring Nightreign, is also available on Steam.

It's an action role-playing game developed by Kojima Productions that features photo-realistic graphics and online multiplayer elements. The Director's Cut version includes additional content not found in the original release.

As of now, you can purchase it digitally on the PlayStation Store for approximately $59.99 USD (prices may vary depending on region). This game fits your criteria while staying below the 90 USD price point you specified. Enjoy exploring the unique post-apocalyptic world in Death Stranding!

In case you're interested in other games from my earlier recommendations, "Stray" and "Halo Infinite" are also action-packed titles with great graphics that you might enjoy. However, they don't meet all your preferences as neither of them is an RPG or has online multiplayer elements in their core gameplay.

tips build for elden ring dex type

To create a Dexterity build in Elden Ring, follow these steps:

1. Focus on increasing Dexterity as your primary stat, aiming to reach the soft cap of 60 Dexterity and then prioritize other stats accordingly. Some recommended secondary stats are Vigor for health, Endurance for stamina, Mind for spell casting, and Strength if you plan to use heavy weapons.

2. Choose a weapon that scales with Dexterity or dex-based weapons like katanas, rapiers, and daggers. You can also consider using dual wielding techniques for faster attacks.

3. Use infusions on your weapons to optimize their damage output. If you're focusing on physical attacks, consider the Flute Shard or Crimson Crystal Tear Ash of War skills to boost your weapon's damage. For spell-based builds, use the Sacred Scorpion Charm or Scarab Curse Ash of War skills for additional magic buffs.

4. Explore the world and defeat bosses to obtain powerful weapons and armor that suit your build. Upgrade your equipment at Smithing Stones to increase their damage output and durability.

5. As you level up, consider investing in skills related to agility, stealth, or spell casting based on your preferred playstyle. Don't forget to upgrade your Talisman slots to unlock powerful passive abilities that can enhance your build further.

6. Experiment with different weapons, armor, and skill combinations to find the perfect setup for your Dexterity build in Elden Ring. Enjoy exploring the Lands Between! 🎮

1. Focus on increasing Faith as your primary stat, aiming to reach the soft cap of 60 Faith and then prioritize other stats accordingly. Some recommended secondary stats are Vigor for health, Endurance for stamina, Mind for spell casting, and Strength if you plan to use heavy incantations or melee weapons.

2. Choose a weapon that scales with Faith, like staffs or incantation-based weapons. You can also consider using incantations that scale with both Faith and Strength for increased damage output.

3. Use infusions on your weapons to optimize their damage output. If you're focusing on spellcasting, consider the Radagon's Soreseal or Mimic Tear Ash of War skills to boost your incantation damage and utility.

4. Explore the world and defeat bosses to obtain powerful incantations and armor that suit your build. Upgrade your equipment at Smithing Stones to increase their damage output and durability.

5. As you level up, consider investing in skills related to spell casting or miracle-based abilities based on your preferred playstyle. Don't forget to upgrade your Talisman slots to unlock powerful passive abilities that can enhance your build further.
